description: Numeric evidence export. No prompts, credentials, local paths or private traces. Not an official benchmark submission.

experiment.isolation: Fresh DB, Scope, workspace, cache and home per arm, case and model attempt; technical finish recovery retains its attempt database.
experiment.baseline: Earlier frozen Gateway OFF batch, same tasks; not simultaneous randomized A/B.
experiment.selection: Initial: first settled valid scored selection. Merged: first successful conditional retry, else last of three valid failures.
experiment.metric: input_tokens + output_tokens; input includes cached input, output includes reasoning; no double count.

MCS.selection: Frozen completed selection at closure; no later discordant retry replacement.
